decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits squarely within the firm's core upholstery knowledge and keeps its own page, so the firm can read its market response and refine it through in-house development.

The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric draws on established decoration know-how, but it is only mentioned on the website and its sibling bouclé leno was already withdrawn, which raises the risk it is pruned in the next collection rotation, though it is not yet enough to drop it.
The flame-retardant jacquard curtain matches the firm's functional contract-textile expertise and its hospitality focus, and its dedicated page signals ongoing commitment.

The double-face wool blend extends existing capabilities and fits the move toward renewable fibres, but low visibility and the planned reduction of hard-to-recycle blends make its future uncertain, so it is kept for now under review.
The newly launched braided-structure fabric builds on established weaving know-how and has its own page, giving the firm a clear way to learn from early results before judging it.
